content.summary: The three tested safe formulations retain the hypotheses needed to avoid Beta’s concrete failure modes. Independent bounded controls support the present wording and implementations; no new repair is required. Both frozen hashes match. These controls do not reconstruct the whole proof or authenticate the external H27 computation.

revisions.action: Rechecked Section 3’s maximum-neighbourhood definition and its graph-degree interpretation.
revisions.result: The earlier correction remains explicit and correctly quantified over actual members.

checks.scope: Safe proper-trace formulation responding to beta-R7-F1.
checks.method: Read D19-model-bridge.md Section 2 and degree19_projection_v5.py build; independently constructed and tested the committed two-completion example.
checks.observation: Lifting P10+P9 through 99 and adjoining {0,6,7,100}, {0,6,7,101} gives 21 distinct four-sets with no sunflower among all 1,330 triples, while core trace 067 occurs twice. A third completion creates a sunflower. Thus the safe coordinate counts all completions, with triple-trace upper bound 2 and full-four upper bound 1; it cannot represent proper traces as binary choices. The actual bridge, code and manuscript Section 3 retain this formulation, and represent the actual exterior point of each selected marker. This control does not satisfy the hypothetical size-68 premise.

checks.scope: Safe complete-C5 resource inequality responding to beta-R4-F1.
checks.method: Inspected internal-proof.md, C5-internal-compatibility.md and check_internal_certificate.py; independently reconstructed Beta’s literal cost witness.
checks.observation: The five P10 triples through 0, triple 124, and a disjoint shifted P10, all lifted through 99, give 16 members with no sunflower among 560 triples. The pair {0,99} has complete link C5, but d(99)=16 and exactly one relevant internal member. Hence d-I<=15 is sharp here, whereas d<=15 is false. The coefficient function removes internal contributions at points 1 and 3, matching the written inequality. The later unadjusted degree cap is applied only after internal exclusion. Completeness of the C5 remains essential; five prescribed edges alone do not establish it.

checks.scope: Safe A3 positivity formulation responding to beta-R7-F1 and the H27 assurance boundary.
checks.method: Checked all eight independent image neighbourhoods and the cyclic identity on eight coordinate basis vectors; derived a general inequality before using occupied-fibre degree bounds.
checks.observation: For order n and independent-neighbourhood cap H, sum b=3n and b_i+b_(i+3)+b_(i+5)=n+a_i imply a_i>=2n-5H. Thus n=68,H=27 gives positivity directly, including initially empty fibres; only afterward may minimum degree imply b_i>=25. The bound becomes -4 at H=28, consistent with the reproduced empty-fibre counterexample. The addendum and Section 6 follow this order without assuming a complete blowup. The algebra verifies the interface, not Jin or H27. Script, results and hashes for all three checks are preserved under checks/round08/alpha/.
